sources.title: Text-to-Image Diffusion Models are AI-Generated Image Quality Scorers
sources.snippet: Consequently, AI-Generated Image Quality Assessment (AGIQA), which aims to assess capabilities of generative models, has gained increasing attention. Diffusion models, pre-trained on large-scale text-image generative tasks, inherently encode rich prior knowledge regarding image quality and text-image alignment, which is crucial for AGIQA task.
